from pathlib import Path
targets = {
    'tests/test_session_log_read_only_entry.py': (
        'expected_exit',
        'exit_code == 3',
        'exit_code == 4',
        'exit_code == 5',
    ),
    'tests/test_session_artifact_safe_storage_entry.py': (
        '(3, \x22partial\x22)',
        '(4, \x22stopped\x22)',
        'exit_code == 4',
        'source_exit_code != ',
    ),
    'tools/session_logs/safe_storage_entry.py': (
        'source_exit_code != EXIT_OK',
        'exit_code = 3',
        'EXIT_STOPPED = 4',
    ),
}
for target, patterns in targets.items():
    text = Path(target).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    print(target)
    for pattern in patterns:
        print(' ', repr(pattern), text.count(pattern))
